##### Project general facts

Ghaff Land Residence is a contemporary mid-rise development designed to offer a balanced and comfortable urban lifestyle. Rising eight storeys, the project features a clean architectural expression with well-proportioned façades and thoughtfully arranged living spaces. A selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious duplex units, are designed with smart layouts and large windows that maximize natural light, creating bright, airy interiors that feel both modern and welcoming.

The development is complemented by a range of lifestyle amenities tailored for everyday convenience and relaxation. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and dedicated children’s play areas, while a multi-purpose recreational space provides the perfect setting for social gatherings and community activities. Every element is designed to create a friendly, family-oriented environment where comfort and connection come together.

Interiors at Ghaff Land Residence feature modern finishes and high-quality materials, emphasizing durability and understated elegance. Apartments are designed with functional kitchens equipped with essential appliances, while living spaces maintain a clean, contemporary aesthetic. The project is offered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Studio City is a dynamic and thriving community located in the heart of Dubai. As a specialized zone dedicated to the media and entertainment industry, it offers a unique and vibrant living experience for residents. Designed to nurture creativity and innovation, Dubai Studio City is a hub for professionals and enthusiasts in the fields of film, broadcasting, music, and other creative disciplines.

The community of Dubai Studio City is meticulously planned to provide a conducive environment for the media and entertainment industry. It is home to state-of-the-art production studios, soundstages, and post-production facilities, attracting renowned local and international companies. The presence of these industry leaders creates a stimulating and inspiring atmosphere, fostering collaboration and growth within the creative community.

Dubai Studio City is not only a place of work and residence but also a center for entertainment and leisure. The community features a range of retail outlets, restaurants, and cafes, providing residents with a variety of dining and shopping options. Additionally, there are recreational facilities, parks, and open spaces where residents can relax, exercise, and enjoy quality time with family and friends.
